name: Aru Fuyu no Monogatari
source: Jun is an average student that lives with his mother in their apartment. During the winter holidays, his childhood friend, Kaede Sakurai helps him with his homework and even some housework. By the time Jun realizes his feelings for Kaede, several misunderstandings have already taken place, and they have already parted ways.
